assumptions: Uses Stata OLS annual cross-sections because the paper does not identify the annual estimator.

Uses the installed asreg FMB Newey-West lag-1 option for the main table coefficient p-values; these are an inference approximation, not Bernard (1995). Adds a separate source-method GSCORE t-statistic using the paper's AR(1) finite-sample factor on the 23 in-memory annual GSCORE coefficients.
Follows Table 7 note for raw BM and raw six-month MOM despite conflicting §4.4 prose.
Uses CRSP monthly returns for May through April and CRSP MSIX monthly capitalization-decile return series; primary-permno security returns, company-level December market capitalization.
Requires complete observed monthly ordinary-return coverage through the end of the return window or delisting month; no ordinary return is zero-filled.
Keeps coherent same-currency financial ratios; translates book equity into USD at its actual statement date using same-date positive unique GBP-to-reporting-currency and GBP-to-USD daily FX legs.

Uses historical Compustat SICH as the primary industry code; falls back only to date-effective CRSP MSENAMES SICCD at the selected financial source date when SICH is unavailable, with zero and ambiguous name intervals unavailable.

Enforces the source's earnings and CFO availability screen before low-BM peer medians; missing current R&D, capex, or advertising stays unavailable, while missing G4/G5 history follows the explicit zero rule.

Maps pre-1988 cash flow using SCF-specific FOPT and WCAPC/Y signs (minus for SCF 1, plus for SCF 2/3/5), uses direct OANCF for SCF 7 when available, and requires the same SCFQ format to difference quarterly YTD cash flows.

limitations: Installed packages do not implement Bernard (1995) inference. Main table p-values use the explicitly labeled Newey-West lag-1 approximation; the separate GSCORE source-method t-statistic uses Pearson corr(beta_t,beta_t-1) over 22 adjacent annual pairs and the paper's AR(1) finite-sample factor.
Table 7-specific raw BM and raw MOM definitions were chosen over conflicting §4.4 log-BM and size-adjusted-MOM prose.

Current Compustat/CRSP vintage, source coverage, quarterly same-date ambiguity handling, historical SIC source overlap, daily FX quote availability for non-USD book equity, CRSP common-share company aggregation, and December size-decile assignment may change sample size; actual native counts govern.
Quarterly XAD is absent in the cataloged FUNDQ; annual-only XAD is taken from the latest same-currency annual statement available by the selected quarterly date, with missing amounts kept missing.

The paper's pre-1988 cash-flow footnote does not state the Compustat WCAPC sign conversion by SCF format or specify early-adopter SCF 7 use of direct OANCF; codebook signs and the direct-measurement exception are documented assumptions.

The Table 2 note's default-zero wording could be read more broadly than the explicit G4/G5 missing-history rule; this build does not zero-fill missing current expenditure inputs, so GSCORE completeness may differ.
The source does not detail portfolio decile breakpoint methodology; annual primary-security size ranks are matched to the source-native CRSP MSIX decile return series.
